historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_3yr_cagr (5.2%) cross-checked against the 10-year revenue CAGR (4.2%); equity CAGR rejected as the primary because JPY251bn of buybacks over FY2024-26 compressed book value (3yr equity CAGR 0.1%) while revenue and profit grew
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 0.1% vs revenue 5.2% and EPS 16.3% -- divergence >30% driven by buybacks (JPY251bn FY2024-26) and the FY2026 one-off head-office gain (JPY41.3bn pre-tax, ~JPY30/share after tax); EPS ex the gain is ~JPY108.6, a 7.3% 3yr CAGR. 5yr revenue CAGR of 8.1% includes JPY depreciation from ~106 to ~150 per USD; underlying local-currency growth is mid-single-digit.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF less SBC less lease principal+interest less interest income): FY2021 ~67.9bn, FY2023 ~30.8bn, FY2026 117.6bn. Owner FCF CAGRs are above reported-FCF CAGRs only because the FY2023 base was depressed by a working-capital build; neither series is a usable growth anchor. SBC is immaterial (0.02% of revenue) so the SBC adjustment does not change the CAGR comparison.

scenario_narratives.base: Seasonings and Foods compounds mid-single-digit in Asia/Africa/LatAm with pricing offsetting raw-material inflation; Healthcare and Others grows faster on ABF (AI/server substrates) and amino acids, lifting group EBITDA margin from 16.0% to 17.0% by FY2031; Frozen Foods flat. FY2027 follows the raised August 2026 guidance (sales 1,732bn, BP 202bn, attributable 123.5bn). Growth fades to 2.5% by FY2035; capex intensity normalises from 6.3% to 5.5% as the ABF/CDMO build-out completes. No FX tailwind after FY2027.
scenario_narratives.bull: The AI packaging-substrate cycle runs for several more years with ABF a near-monopoly input, Forge Biologics CDMO turns profitable and scales, and the ASV 2030 roadmap's ROIC and EPS targets are met: revenue CAGR ~7% to FY2030, EBITDA margin 18.5%, terminal growth 2.5%.
scenario_narratives.bear: A semiconductor capex downturn in FY2028 removes the driver behind the recent guidance raises while a stronger yen reverses translation gains; North America Frozen Foods remains structurally weak and other operating charges (impairments, restructuring) stay at the FY2025-26 level rather than falling to guidance. Revenue dips in FY2028 and recovers slowly; EBITDA margin settles at 15.0%; terminal multiple capped at 16x FCF.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Ajinomoto is valued as a single owner-FCF stream: a defensive seasonings franchise funding a cyclical, high-margin ABF electronic-materials business and an unproven CDMO. Business profit is normalised for the recurring below-the-line charges management itself budgets, the FY2026 head-office gain is excluded, leases are charged as operating cost, and minority leakage is in the tax driver. The gap between the DCF and the market price is the price the market is paying for the AI/ABF growth optionality and the buyback programme; a 15% hurdle entry price sits far below both.
key_risks_to_valuation: Semiconductor packaging (ABF) cycle: the FY2027 guidance raises are entirely attributable to Healthcare and Others; a capex downturn removes the growth kicker (bear case)
FX: 64% of sales overseas; guidance built on USD/JPY 150, a 10% yen appreciation is roughly -6% on group sales and more on profit
Normalised other operating charges: the model assumes ~1.2% of revenue; FY2025 ran at ~3% (impairments, Althea sale) and a return to that level is worth ~2pp of EBITDA margin
Capex intensity: 6.3% assumed to fade to 5.5%; if ABF/CDMO capacity needs keep it at 6.5%+, owner FCF margin falls ~1pp
Working-capital reversal: FY2026 OCF carried a ~34bn payables inflow that the FY2027 Q1 (OCF 18.4bn, inventories +31bn) has already partly given back
Terminal value is ~65-70% of EV at a 7% JPY WACC; each 1pp of WACC moves the base value roughly 20%

inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 Securities Report consolidated statement of changes in equity, 'Stock-based remuneration transaction' JPY251m (line 10094); FY2025 JPY352m. Medium-term Stock-based Incentive (MTI/BIP trust) plan for directors only; no equity-award taxes disclosed (0).
inputs.buyback_note: FY2026 purchase of treasury stock JPY130,009m (cash flow statement line 1026); JPY90,695m FY2025; JPY19,373m in Q1 FY2027. Company is a heavy repurchaser (total return ratio target 50%+ over three years). Count held flat regardless: buybacks are value-neutral in this model and SBC is immaterial, so the flat count is not a convention the company has yet to pay for.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-26T05:10:56Z (intraday TSE print, 14:10 JST; regular close 06:30Z -- refresh_price.py replaces it after the DCF JSON exists)
inputs.share_count_basis: 977,735,616 issued less 23,173,875 treasury (incl. 792,000 BIP-trust shares) at 2026-06-30 per Q1 FY2027 tanshin = 954.56m; dilutive potential shares 36k (FY2026 EPS note) are immaterial. Post 2-for-1 split (April 2025). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows (JPY251m) and there is no non-SBC issuance.
inputs.net_debt_basis: Bonds and borrowings only at 2026-06-30: short-term borrowings 7,069 + commercial paper 140,000 + current bonds 29,991 + current LT borrowings 4,048 + corporate bonds 174,531 + LT borrowings 206,280 = 561,919; less cash 196,979. Lease liabilities (61,315 at FY2026, inside 'Other financial liabilities') EXCLUDED because the full lease payment is charged in the flows (treatment B). Q1 gross cash and gross debt both rose ~JPY90bn on a JPY140bn CP issuance; net debt rose JPY50bn from FY2026 year-end on buybacks, dividends and the seasonal inventory build.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in JPY, the currency of the flows: 10y JGB ~1.7% risk-free + 5.5% ERP x beta 1.0 = 7.2% cost of equity (beta set at 1.0 rather than a staples 0.6-0.7 because 64% of sales and most of the growth sit in overseas/EM currencies and the semiconductor ABF cycle); after-tax cost of debt ~0.6% (bonds 0.13-2.07%) at an 11% debt weight gives a blended 6.5%, rounded to 7.0% for the house grid. Same WACC in all three scenarios -- cyclicality and FX risk are charged in the flows, not stacked in the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) Leases as operating cost. Full lease payment deducted inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path: FY2026 principal 9,630 (cash flow statement line 1029) + interest on lease liabilities 681 (Securities Report line 11745) = 10,311 = 0.65% of revenue, lifted to 0.85% from FY2027 for the new TODA head-office lease (+34,076 lease liability added in FY2026, Securities Report line 12381). Lease liabilities therefore excluded from net debt, and da_pct_path is D&A ex right-of-use depreciation (88,914 total less ~9,600 ROU = ~79,300 = 5.0%).
inputs.nci_treatment: Folded into the combined cash_tax_rate_path. NCI took 10,385 of 145,060 FY2026 profit (7.2%; 10,501 of 80,773 in FY2025). Combined leakage = 1 - (1 - 0.27 standard tax) x (1 - 0.072) = 32.1% -> 32.0% path. NCI equity (73,845 at 2026-06-30) is NOT deducted in the bridge, so the leakage is charged once. Calibration: FY2027 guidance BP 202bn less ~20bn normalised other operating charges less ~1bn net finance = ~181bn pre-tax; x (1 - 0.32) = ~123bn vs guided attributable profit 123.5bn.
inputs.ebitda_definition: Business profit (IFRS, includes share of associates' profit, excludes other operating income/expenses) LESS normalised other operating expenses net (~1.2% of revenue; FY2026 ~33bn gross incl. impairments/restructuring, FY2025 ~50bn, FY2027 guidance implies ~20bn) PLUS total D&A (post-IFRS 16). FY2026: (181,163 - ~33,000 + 88,914)/1,583,719 = 15.0%; FY2027 guidance: (202,000 - ~20,000 + ~95,000)/1,732,000 = 16.0%. The 41,265 gain on the head-office sale is excluded (it sits in other operating income, outside BP).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (dcf-methods routing: operating company, non-US; adaptations file read -- currency-matched JPY WACC, single lease treatment (B), NCI charged once via leakage driver, matching assets in the bridge, SBC-zero market). Fresh build, no prior DCF. OWNER FCF FY0: reported FCF 134,801 (OCF 239,351 less PPE 96,446 less intangibles 8,104) less SBC 251 less interest income 6,601 less lease cash 10,311 = 117,638. Interest income is stripped because the component build runs off business profit, which excludes finance income; the matching assets (cash in net debt; current other financial assets 38,259 and long-term financial assets 49,176 in equity_bridge) are added back. Associates (139,986) are NOT in the bridge because their profit share is inside business profit. FY2026 OCF was flattered by a ~34bn working-capital inflow (payables +63bn) and cash tax of 39.3bn against ~51bn expense (tax on the head-office gain falls into FY2027), so the component year-1 owner FCF of ~82bn (4.7% of revenue) is the better normalised base. SBC-ZERO: SBC 0.02% of revenue, house and street coincide; band_position is degenerate and should be read as n/a. Price is an intraday print and is replaced by refresh_price.py.

bear.narrative: FY2027 misses guidance modestly (7% growth) as Middle East escalation and tariffs bite; FY2028 semiconductor capex downturn cuts ABF volumes and the yen strengthens toward 130 (translation -8-10% on 64% overseas sales), so revenue falls 1% and EBITDA margin drops to 14.3%; Frozen Foods stays loss-making in North America; margin recovers only to 15.0%. Terminal cap lowered to 16x because the growth kicker is gone.

base.growth_rationale: FY2027 = raised guidance (sales 1,732bn, +9.4%, at USD/JPY 150). FY2028-31 fade from 5.5% to 4.0%: the ASV 2030 roadmap's mid-single-digit organic growth with ABF/Healthcare growing faster than Seasonings; no further FX tailwind assumed. Terminal 2.0% ~ blended JPY/overseas nominal growth.
base.margin_rationale: 16.0% FY2027 from guidance (BP 202bn less ~20bn other charges plus ~95bn D&A); rises 1pp over four years as Healthcare & Others (ABF, bio-pharma) mix grows and Frozen Foods stabilises, then flat. FY2026 actual on the same definition was 15.0%.
base.capex_rationale: FY2026 capex 104.6bn = 6.6% (ABF capacity, Forge CDMO, new plants); FY2025 6.2%; FY2023-24 5.0-5.4%. Starts at 6.3% and fades to 5.5% as the current capacity cycle completes; D&A ex-ROU drifts 5.0% -> 5.3% behind it.
base.wc_rationale: Net working capital (inventories 350bn + receivables 203bn - payables 294bn) is ~15% of revenue; growth consumes cash, so capture is negative. -10% rather than -15% because the group has been pushing payables (DPO rose sharply FY2025-26).

bull.narrative: ABF supercycle persists through FY2030 (Q1 FY2027 progress rate on Healthcare BP already 29.6%), Forge Biologics CDMO reaches EBITDA breakeven and scales, yen stays near 150, Frozen Foods North America recovers margin; EBITDA margin reaches 18.5% (BP margin ~13%), consistent with the ASV 2030 target of ~3x FY2022 EPS.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 20x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Moved from the house 15/50/35. Bear raised to 25% because a large share of recent profit growth and both guidance raises rest on the cyclical ABF/semiconductor line, and the Analysis grades FX exposure (64% overseas, guidance at USD/JPY 150) and geopolitical risk as high. Bull cut to 25% because it needs three independent things to go right (ABF cycle persists, Forge CDMO scales, Frozen Foods recovers).
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
